status: active; CLIP-only; descriptor v14 extreme brightness; joint descriptor-tail endpoints and centroids; palette-only gray/skin protection
default_note: OpenAI CLIP ViT-B/32 is the selected inference and autotune model. Warmth and saturation are unprotected; palette alone has gray/skin protection.

autotune.endpoint_rule: direction-aligned 90th percentile; positive q90, negative q10
autotune.pole_endpoint_selection: Per-descriptor median physical setting over seven images; direction-aligned q90 across the 16 descriptor medians
autotune.historical_alternative_model: SigLIP; retained only in legacy comparison records

centroid_policy.selection: Top ceil(10% of 16) descriptors by the same direction-aligned median ISP setting used for endpoint selection
centroid_policy.embedding: L2-normalize each selected CLIP descriptor embedding, average, then L2-normalize the centroid
centroid_policy.mapping_query: L2-normalize CLIP query embedding before projection

protection.metric: Euclidean distance between normalized linear-RGB chromaticities; no luminance term
protection.skin_reference_status: provisional comparison reference; not validated segmentation

contrast_rendering.mapping: add the target-minus-input luminance shift equally to RGB channels
contrast_rendering.gamut_compression_domain: sRGB before inverse transfer, with gamut compression preserving luma and reducing chroma as needed
contrast_rendering.shadow_chroma_gain: no multiplicative gain; measured p95 ratio <= 1.06 on images 2, 33, and 384
